large.label: Orchard tractor
large.coordinate_system: X right, Y back, Z up; front -Y
large.origin: XY grid center, bottom grid plane Z=0
notes: Original olive tractor with physical diagonal tread blocks, stepped round mudguards, radiator, lamps, mirrors, side steps, exhaust and a rear three-point hitch/PTO.
Glazing is an opaque palette color; no transparency or interior simulation is claimed.
Functional frame members and hitch are at least 3-5 large cells thick. Half uses the shared conservative grid reducer without mesh scaling.
large.half_method: 2x2x2 nonempty majority; color index breaks ties; optional documented detail correction
large.uv: No texture UV required: per-face solid palette PBR materials

large.label: Timber harvest barn
large.coordinate_system: X right, Y back, Z up; front -Y
large.origin: XY grid center, bottom grid plane Z=0
notes: Hollow timber barn with individually modeled open front door leaves, braces and hinges, visible hay bales, roof shell, ridge tiles, side windows and interior trusses.
Rear has a separate service door and loft window. Eave gutters and downpipes serve both roof sides.
Stone courses and regular timber/roof divisions are deterministic structural detailing, not random surface noise.
